# Let's Talk Statistics

https://letstalkstatistics.com

Charts of official U.S. government statistics. Each chart lists the publisher, the series URL, the retrieval date, the units, and whether the values are nominal or inflation-adjusted.

## Pages

- https://letstalkstatistics.com/
- https://letstalkstatistics.com/prices
- https://letstalkstatistics.com/budget
- https://letstalkstatistics.com/economy
- https://letstalkstatistics.com/energy
- https://letstalkstatistics.com/crime
- https://letstalkstatistics.com/immigration
- https://letstalkstatistics.com/sources

## Data

Numbers come from frontend/data/site.json, produced by scripts/fetch from the files in data/raw. A chart is omitted when its source file was not fetched. The crime page states which FBI file was skipped. Immigration charts use DHS Yearbook Table 1 and the CBP nationwide encounters workbooks. Energy charts use the EIA Monthly Energy Review bulk file, the EIA international bulk file, and World Bank population. See https://letstalkstatistics.com/sources for publishers, retrieval dates, and SHA-256 hashes.
